name: PhotoGalleryOptionsType
summary:
Simple object for specifying options to
[openPhotoGallery](api:Titanium.Media#openPhotoGallery).

properties.name: allowEditing
properties.summary: Specifies if the media should be editable after capture/selection.

properties.name: allowMultiple
properties.summary: Specifies if the user should be able to select multiple photos.
properties.description: The allowMultiple property is only available on Android API 18 and above.

properties.name: allowTranscoding
properties.summary: Specifies if the video should be transcoded (using highest quality preset) . If set to false no video transcoding will be performed.

properties.name: animated
properties.summary: Specifies if the dialog should be animated upon showing and hiding.

properties.name: arrowDirection
properties.summary: Controls the type of arrow and position of the popover.

properties.name: autohide
properties.summary:
Specifies if the photo gallery should be hidden automatically after the media
selection is completed.

properties.name: cancel
properties.summary: Function to call if the user presses the cancel button.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: Function to call upon receiving an error.

properties.name: maxImages
properties.summary: Specifies the number of images a user can select at maximum.
properties.description: Only available on Android API 21 and above and with `allowMultiple:true`

properties.name: mediaTypes
properties.summary:
Array of media type constants to allow.

Live photos is only supported on the iOS platform, starting with iOS 9.1. If you want
to allow live photos with [Titanium.Media.MEDIA_TYPE_LIVEPHOTO](api:Titanium.Media#MEDIA_TYPE_LIVEPHOTO), you also need to specify
at least [Titanium.Media.MEDIA_TYPE_PHOTO](api:Titanium.Media#MEDIA_TYPE_PHOTO) as a fallback. If you do not allow live
photos, they still can be selected, but will be represented as a normal static photo.

properties.name: pathOnly
properties.summary: Do not include the blob in the result

properties.name: popoverView
properties.summary: View to position the photo gallery popover on top of.

properties.name: selectionLimit
properties.summary: Specifies number of media item that can be selected.
properties.description:
Setting this property to zero allows you to select maximum number of media supported by system.
This will work only when [PhotoGalleryOptionsType.allowMultiple](api:PhotoGalleryOptionsType#allowMultiple) is `true`.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: Function to call when the photo gallery is closed after a successful selection.
properties.description:
If [PhotoGalleryOptionsType.allowMultiple](api:PhotoGalleryOptionsType#allowMultiple) is `true`, then Callback[CameraMediaMultipleItemsType](api:CameraMediaMultipleItemsType) will be invoked.
Otherwise Callback[CameraMediaItemType](api:CameraMediaItemType) will be invoked for single selection.

inlined.name: CameraMediaMultipleItemsType
inlined.summary: A media object from photo gallery when [PhotoGalleryOptionsType.allowMultiple](api:PhotoGalleryOptionsType#allowMultiple) is `true`.

properties.name: livePhotos
properties.summary: The list of selected live photo objects.
